segment.source: Navigate carefully through the gates. You have [[8.5 minutes]] to finish the course. If you get too far off track you may press [[H]] to abort this run. Each missed gate incurs a [[15 second]] time penalty.
segment.target: 小心穿越各道 閘門。你有 [[8.5 分鐘]] 完成賽道。如果 偏離航道太遠， 可按 [[H]] 中止這次 挑戰。每錯過一道閘門 會被罰時 [[15 秒]]。

segment.source: On this level you have [[6 minutes]] to complete the course. For each target you destroy you receive a [[2 second]] time bonus. Learn to configure your shields for greater safety.
segment.target: 本關你有 [[6 分鐘]]完成 賽道。每摧毀 一個目標，可獲得 [[2 秒]]的時間獎勵。 學會調配你的 護盾，以策安全。

segment.source: On this level you have a time limit of [[4.5 minutes]]. The course is more [[difficult]] and there are more targets. Destroy as many [[targets]] as you can to increase your time limit.
segment.target: 本關的時間 限制為 [[4.5 分鐘]]。 賽道更加[[困難]]， 目標也更多。 盡量多摧毀[[目標]]， 藉此延長你的 時間限制。

segment.source: On this level you have only [[3 minutes]] to complete the course. Reconfigure your power system to gain [[extra]] speed. Nearly every panel has a [[full complement]] of targets. Can you destroy them all?
segment.target: 本關你只有 [[3 分鐘]]完成 賽道。重新調配你的 動力系統以獲得[[額外]] 速度。幾乎每塊面板都 [[佈滿]]了目標。 你能全部摧毀嗎？

segment.source: Keep a careful balance between speed and shields. You have [[5.5 minutes]] to complete the course. Complete this level to earn a promotion to [[flight officer]].
segment.target: 在速度與護盾之間 謹慎取得平衡。你有 [[5.5 分鐘]]完成 賽道。 完成本關即可 晉升為[[飛行准尉]]。

segment.source: On this level the course is more [[difficult[[ and there are more targets. Configure your shields to full power forward. You have [[5 minutes]] to complete this level.
segment.target: 本關賽道 更加[[困難[[， 目標也更多。 將護盾調整為 全力集中前方。 你有 [[5 分鐘]] 完成本關。

segment.source: On this level all platforms are [[fully]] loaded with firing targets. If you have time try to find a [[safe]] place to slow down and recharge your shields. You have [[5 minutes]] to complete this level.
segment.target: 本關所有平台都 [[滿載]]會開火的 目標。有時間的話， 找個[[安全]]的地方減速， 為你的 護盾充能。你有 [[5 分鐘]] 完成本關。

segment.source: This is the [[most]] difficult course. Some panels are set up to shoot at you from behind. You have a [[4.5 minute]] time limit. Complete this level to earn your [[flight badge]]. [[May the Force be with you.]]
segment.target: 這是[[最]]困難的 賽道。部分面板 會從你背後 開火。時間限制為 [[4.5 分鐘]]。 完成本關即可 獲得[[飛行徽章]]。 [[願原力與你同在。]]
